comments.body:
> This needs a little bit of reorganizing.
> 
> 1. Split into two commits.
>    
>    1. The first only changes `features.macro`. Also write a better commit message. e.g. "Disable featureBatch and featureBatchInnerSigs amendments", and you can include the PR number since you have one now.
>    2. The second changes the version number. The commit message will match previous version-setting commits: "Set version to X.Y.Z".
> 2. I also thought that this PR was going to set the version to "3.1.1-rc1", but if I'm wrong about that, nevermind.

Done. I had to add a 3rd commit with an update to the macOS build environment, because the environment was updated since 3.1.0.

## High Level Overview of Change

This hotfix release marks Batch and fixBatchInnerSigs as unsupported, pending further investigation.

### Context of Change



### Type of Change



- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactor (non-breaking change that only restructures code)
- [ ] Performance (increase or change in throughput and/or latency)
- [ ] Tests (you added tests for code that already exists, or your new feature included in this PR)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Chore (no impact to binary, e.g. `.gitignore`, formatting, dropping support for older tooling)
- [x] Release

### API Impact



- [ ] Public API: New feature (new methods and/or new fields)
- [ ] Public API: Breaking change (in general, breaking changes should only impact the next api_version)
- [ ] `libxrpl` change (any change that may affect `libxrpl` or dependents of `libxrpl`)
- [ ] Peer protocol change (must be backward compatible or bump the peer protocol version)

reviews.author: ximinez
reviews.body:
This needs a little bit of reorganizing.

1. Split into two commits.
	1. The first only changes `features.macro`. Also write a better commit message. e.g. "Disable featureBatch and featureBatchInnerSigs amendments", and you can include the PR number since you have one now.
	2. The second changes the version number. The commit message will match previous version-setting commits: "Set version to X.Y.Z".
2. I also thought that this PR was going to set the version to "3.1.1-rc1", but if I'm wrong about that, nevermind.
